# Shepherd.js

> Guided product tours for the web. Steps are accessible dialogs that attach to DOM
> elements. Runs in the browser, with no backend. Free for noncommercial use
> (PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0) and a 30-day evaluation; commercial products need
> a one-time commercial license.

Read `AGENTS.md` in this package before writing code. It has a working example and the
mistakes to avoid. Option docs are in `dist/js/shepherd.d.mts`.

```js
import Shepherd from 'shepherd.js';
import 'shepherd.js/dist/css/shepherd.css'; // Required. Not included by the JS import.

const tour = new Shepherd.Tour({ useModalOverlay: true });
tour.addStep({
  title: 'Save',
  text: 'Saves your work.',
  attachTo: { element: '#save', on: 'bottom' }, // top, bottom, left, right, auto; optional -start or -end
  buttons: [{ text: 'Done', action: 'complete' }] // 'next', 'back', 'cancel', 'complete', or a function
});
tour.start();
```

Gaps and edge distance go in `positionOptions: { offset, padding, strategy, flip }`.
Shepherd runs no Floating UI middleware, so there is no `floatingUIOptions`.

## Files in this package

- `AGENTS.md`: how to use the library correctly
- `tour.schema.json`: JSON Schema for a tour written as plain data
- `dist/js/shepherd.d.mts`: types and option docs
- `dist/js/shepherd.mjs`: ES module with no global. Import it.
- `dist/css/shepherd.css`: the stylesheet
- `dist/css/theme.css`: an optional theme, loaded after the stylesheet
- `shepherd.js/motion`: optional `glideSteps` and `stepProgress`
